You are P2. Players: P1, P2, P3 (3 players in total, including you).
This match has exactly 7 rounds. Current round: 6 of 7.
Your goal is to maximize your own cumulative payoff across this match. Final standings compare cumulative payoffs; equal cumulative payoffs are tied.

Rules:
- Each player chooses one integer from 0 to 100, inclusive, each round.
- The target is 2/3 of the group average, including your own choice.
- The players closest to the target share the round prize equally. The total prize is 1 point: one winner gets 1, two get 1/2 each, three get 1/3 each.
- Current-round choices stay hidden until every player has submitted. After each round, everyone sees all choices, the average, target, winners, and payoffs.
- Only this match's completed history is available. A new match starts with no prior history and zero payoffs. Fractions in the history are exact values.
